name: eWpG Bond Desk
description: Paying agent for a German eWpG-registered bond issued as a full ERC-3643 (T-REX) security token. Demonstrates the two authority layers a real eWpG instrument stacks on Registerwerk: T-REX agent rights (mint/burn on the bond token itself) plus ecosystem permission gating (which org/human may trigger issuance, coupon payment, or redemption), with independent ONCHAINID claim checks (KYC, AML) enforced through RegisterwerkGated and the PermissionOracle. Every desk function is bound to the issuer org the instance was deployed for (operatorOrg). Coupon schedule: anchored on maturity (the final period falls due exactly at maturity); when the term is not a whole number of intervals the first period is a short stub that is pro-rated by day count (counted to the second, ICMA actual/actual with the regular interval as the notional period) instead of paying a full coupon, and every later period pays the full coupon. Runbook order at maturity: call payCoupon for the final period first (it opens no period after maturity), then redeem each holder - redeem reverts until the final period is open. Frozen holders: only the frozen share of a coupon is withheld (the whole coupon if the address is frozen, only the frozen units' share if some units are frozen) and the rest is paid at once. The withheld share is moved from the treasury into the desk's own escrow, so it stays backed, and it remains claimable: once the holder has no frozen units left, claimWithheldCoupon (callable by anyone, it pays the holder only) releases it, or a legal order directs it to a named destination (releaseWithheld). Redemption of a frozen position reverts and is served only under a legal order to the destination it names (forceRedeem).

requiredPermissions.rationale: Sell new bond units to a KYC'd investor against a stablecoin payment (primary-market DvP)
Pay the current coupon period to each holder in the payment-rail stablecoin
Pay principal and burn a matured holder's position at redemption, after the final coupon period is open
Suspend and resume every desk function that moves the payment leg (subscription, coupon, redemption and legal-order payouts), e.g. when the settlement rail is disabled
Execute a legal order for a frozen holder: release a withheld coupon or force-redeem the matured position to the destination named in the order, recording its legal basis on chain

paymentMethods.note: Primary-market subscription plus coupon and redemption payouts in AllUnity Euro
Alternative settlement currency for USD-denominated investors
Atomic delivery-versus-payment of bond units against the stablecoin leg for secondary-market transfers
